findings.claim: The change adds a 14-role manifest roster without updating the required roster source in docs/agent-team.md, so the manifest cannot be shown to define exactly the roster in that document.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion: `.agent-team/team.json` SHALL define exactly the roster in `docs/agent-team.md`; diff adds the 14-role roster in `.agent-team/team.config.json` but contains no hunk modifying `docs/agent-team.md`.
findings.suggested_fix: Update `docs/agent-team.md` to list the exact 14-role roster, including the five new domain roles, and keep it in sync with `.agent-team/team.config.json`/generated `team.json`.
